functional_support_definition: F is the externally declared biological function supplied by the required role, not a taxon occurrence proxy
equivalence_conditions: F(k) is defined exactly as support by at least one member of R(k)
member answers and F refer to the same frozen event key
adequacy and evidence-completeness semantics are aligned
incomplete_set_consequence: All represented members can be adequately negative while the member-level relation remains unresolved because an unrepresented alternative may exist.
direct_functional_channel_consequence: A separately validated aggregate functional channel can establish F(k)=false without enumerating every provider species, but only if its observation/estimator adequacy supports functional absence at that key.
design_implication: Cross-role hard relations have two legitimate routes: externally close the alternative-member universe, or directly observe/model the required biological function as a complete aggregate channel. These routes must not be conflated.
